source.title: Londonderry Standard, 21 May 1958, p. 3 ("Coleraine Rural Council: 21 nominations for 21 seats; all outgoing members unopposed"); Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1958, p. 4 ("Coleraine R.D.C.: all the outgoing members returned unopposed")
source.publisher: Londonderry Standard (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There were 21 nominations for 21 seats. All outgoing members were unopposed' (Londonderry Standard 21 May 1958 p3; Londonderry Sentinel 22 May 1958 p4, which prints the same list by division).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No Coleraine rural contest was reported in the class-wide nominations report, which records contests elsewhere in the county (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 11); the division-level list was not retrieved. All 21 members added: there were 21 nominations for the 21 seats and all were returned unopposed (Londonderry Standard, 21 May 1958, p. 3; Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1958, p. 4) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
